title: PolyGate Policy Store (ConfigMap document)
description: The complete persisted policy document written to / mounted from the polygate-routing-policy ConfigMap. Holds the active version pointer plus the most recent 20 full version records.

active_version.description: Version number of the currently active policy. Must match the version of exactly one record in 'versions' whose status is 'active'.

versions.description: Full version records, newest kept up to 20. When a 21st is published the oldest non-active record is dropped.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Never reused, even on rollback.

change_note.description: Required audit note describing the change.

rollback_from.description: If produced by a rollback, the version number it copied content from; otherwise null.
